commands.label: ventoy-xubuntu-iso
commands.note: Runs after Ventoy installs. Copies ISO to D:\ — no UAC needed.

commands.label: ventoy-install
commands.note: UAC prompt will appear for Ventoy2Disk /I D:
commands.command: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "$v='C:\Users\endos\Signal\ventoy'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $v | Out-Null; Invoke-WebRequest 'https://github.com/ventoy/Ventoy/releases/download/v1.0.99/ventoy-1.0.99-windows.zip' -OutFile "$v\ventoy.zip"; Expand-Archive "$v\ventoy.zip" -DestinationPath $v -Force; $exe=(Get-ChildItem $v -Recurse -Filter 'Ventoy2Disk.exe' | Select-Object -First 1).FullName; Start-Process $exe -ArgumentList '/I D:' -Verb RunAs -Wait"

commands.label: watchdog-reg
commands.command: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "$vbs = '$wsh = New-Object -ComObject WScript.Shell; $wsh.Run(\"powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -WindowStyle Hidden -File C:\\Users\\endos\\Signal\\relay\\claude_watchdog.ps1\", 0, $false)'; Set-Content -Path $env:TEMP\watchdog_launch.vbs -Value $vbs; $action = New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute 'wscript.exe' -Argument "$env:TEMP\watchdog_launch.vbs"; $trigger1 = New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -AtLogOn; $settings = New-ScheduledTaskSettingsSet -ExecutionTimeLimit 0; Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'ClaudeWatchdog' -Action $action -Trigger $trigger1 -Settings $settings -RunLevel Highest -Force"
